name: Dual-Momentum TQQQ
tagline: A 12-month QQQ/SPY dual-momentum gate that holds a volatility-sized TQQQ sleeve only when Nasdaq trend and relative strength agree.
summary: Holds TQQQ at min(1, 0.85 / rv10) when QQQ's 12-month return is positive and QQQ is beating SPY, rotates to QQQ when only absolute momentum is positive, and holds BIL otherwise; a 20-session confirmation filters state whipsaws. On 2016-2023 it returns 41.15% CAGR with a 57.95% max drawdown, but the edge is concentrated in 2019-2020 and in avoiding 2022.
caveat: Dev-only and not counted: the 58% max drawdown is essentially TQQQ's Q4-2018 drawdown, the 252-session lookback is load-bearing (126/189 fail), and 10.5% of placebo reorderings match or beat it.
